name: pro.appeak/appeak-pro
title: Appeak Pro: App Store Optimization
description: ASO and AI discoverability: audit App Store and Google Play listings, metadata, ranks, competitors.

tools.name: audit_listing
tools.description: ASO audit of a live App Store or Google Play listing: each part (title, subtitle or short description, description, screenshots, ratings, localization) graded Working / Worth a look / Fix this with the reason, the listing's facts, and the biggest gaps. Rule-based, from the public listing.

store_url.description: The app's App Store or Google Play link, e.g. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id570060128

country.description: Two-letter store country (us, gb, de...). Defaults to the link's country, else us.

tools.name: check_metadata
tools.description: Checks a draft title, App Store subtitle or Google Play short description, keyword field, description and promotional text against the store's rules: character limits, words repeated across fields, wasted keyword-field space, policy words. Use it on any listing copy you write or review. No store call.

platform.description: ios = App Store, android = Google Play

subtitle.description: App Store subtitle, or Google Play short description

keywords.description: App Store keyword field, comma separated

tools.name: check_keyword_ranks
tools.description: Where an app ranks in the store's own search for up to 5 searches (top 50), with the apps on top. Without searches, checks the phrases its title and subtitle are written for.

store_url.description: The app's App Store or Google Play link, e.g. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id570060128

searches.description: Searches people type, e.g. ["budget planner", "expense tracker"]

country.description: Two-letter store country (us, gb, de...). Defaults to the link's country, else us.

tools.name: find_competitors
tools.description: The apps that rank above this one in the searches its listing is written for, with the searches each one tops.

store_url.description: The app's App Store or Google Play link, e.g. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id570060128

country.description: Two-letter store country (us, gb, de...). Defaults to the link's country, else us.

tools.name: check_ai_visibility
tools.description: Asks ChatGPT (with web search) up to three generic questions a person would ask when looking for an app like this one, with the app's name left out (e.g. "What's the best app to learn a new language?"), and says whether it names the app, at what position, and which apps it recommends instead. Answers are reused for a week.

store_url.description: The app's App Store or Google Play link, e.g. https://apps.apple.com/us/app/id570060128

country.description: Two-letter store country (us, gb, de...). Defaults to the link's country, else us.

tools.name: search_aso_guide
tools.description: Finds articles in the Appeak Pro ASO Guide for an App Store Optimization question (keywords, screenshots, ratings, localization, Google Play tags, AI discoverability...).

query.description: The question, e.g. "how to pick google play tags"
